description: Control arm (claude-code-stock) and treatment arm (claude-code-tether) share run-prepare.js EXCEPT the treatment arm adds the tetherSetup and gated onboard blocks (per evals/margin/CLAUDE.md). The shared baseline (claudeDir/env/claudeState setup and the agent launch command construction) must stay aligned across both files; a change to the control baseline not mirrored into the treatment arm, or a change to the treatment arm's non-tether sections, silently makes the arms differ on something other than tether.
